title: White Fish with Fresh Beans and Pico de Gallo
blurb: Pan-fried white fish topped with a fresh salsa of tomatoes, red pepper, coriander and lemon, served alongside tender green beans.
steps: Trim the green beans and cook them in boiling salted water for 5 minutes until tender, then drain and set aside.
Finely chop the tomatoes, red pepper and red onion, then place them in a bowl.
Roughly chop the coriander and add it to the bowl along with the juice of the lemon, a pinch of salt and some black pepper, then stir to combine.
Pat the fish fillets dry with kitchen paper and season both sides with salt and pepper.
Heat half the olive oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat and cook the fish for 3 to 4 minutes on each side until golden and cooked through.
Warm the green beans in the remaining olive oil in a separate pan for a minute or two.
Serve the fish on plates with the green beans alongside and spoon the pico de gallo over the top of the fish.
